title: The Development of the Electron Microscope and of Electron Microscopy
lineage: Participant Nobel lecture. The 1938 ordered instrument was planned, not yet built or tested.

passages.note: Printed pp. 368–370 / PDF pp. 14–15: 1938 biological investigations and orders; first series instrument delivered to Hoechst by end 1939.
Printed p. 365 / PDF p. 11: Müller’s specimen work and 1935 micrograph.
